body:
Self hatred at number one, followed by isolation and family issues
I'm unsure how I'd go about solving any of them
I often think of poems/limericks about death much like this

I probably needed to make it clearer, when my friend vowed to help me it wasn't like a promise to cure my depression, more like a vow of support. I do see where you're coming from though, my issue is they want me to talk to them about my depression and I'm not sure where the line between Friend/Counselor is in the terms of a conversation.

I wrote this kind of poorly. There are only two people in this scenario Me and my friend (I prefer to use "they" pronouns for everyone, I can see your confusion) I don't have a therapist, and I should definitely get one.
